rationale: Storm-caused damage to the policyholder's own garage roof, parked vehicle (auto comprehensive), and fence is straightforward property damage; auto damage is covered under auto comprehensive, but the primary structure/roof loss drives classification to property_damage queue.
claim_summary: Storm damage claim for POL-1008 (Avery Santos). Major overnight storm caused damage to garage roof, parked vehicle, and shared fence; possible debris was either falling tree or part of neighbor's shed. Emergency services present on-scene. Policyholder unable to fully assess due to ongoing emergency response. Adjuster on-site inspection urgently needed to determine source of damage and third-party liability implications.

case_facts.description: tree or part of neighbor's shed blew through property during major storm

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is clearly property damage to the home.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports wind damage to four shingles on the back porch overhang following last weekend's wind event. No interior water damage. Estimated repair cost is $400, which falls below the $2,500 deductible.

case_facts.damage_description: four shingles blown off, no interior water damage
